findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 6 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 114 questions numbered 1-114; by section: 6.1 10, 6.2 12, 6.3 7, 6.4 14, 6.5 10, 6.6 17, 6.7 18, 6.8 11, 6.9 8, 6.10 7. Keys: {'a': 29, 'b': 28, 'c': 28, 'd': 29}.

Covers every section in book order: data science and its interdisciplinary nature, data, structured and unstructured data, data sources and collection, storage and management, machine learning, learning from data, traditional programming vs machine learning, supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning, applications in healthcare, business, education and daily life, model building (features, target, feature engineering, train-test split, the hours-vs-scores regression example), accuracy, error, precision, recall, F1-score, validation, hyperparameter tuning and the speaker analogy, robustness, prediction and causality, and the tools Excel, R, Python and Jupyter. None repeats the chapter exercise. Metric numericals use changed values and were computed in Python; the regression example uses the corrected output (MSE 0.1484, slope 0.6552, intercept 0.1466; the printed program alone prints only the unrounded MSE).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
